citation: Tabela Brasileira de Composicao de Alimentos (TBCA), Tabelas complementares: Perfil de Carboidratos, Versao 7.0, 2019
unit: g/100 g of the edible portion, integral basis, which is already this store's basis
method: resistant starch by AOAC 2002.02, with the final glucose step determined enzymatically
note: A component-specific supplementary release, separate from TBCA's ordinary nutrient tables and easy to miss if only the main database is inspected. Its unusual virtue is that it prints the moisture of each sample in the column beside the analyte, so the basis is checkable per row rather than assumed.
component: resistant starch only. The release also carries total fructans, fibre fractions, starch and sugars, none of which is taken here: total fructans is not inulin and relabelling it would be a fabrication.
reading: The PDF's tables are read by their column order: identifier, name, n, moisture mean, moisture deviation, resistant starch mean, resistant starch deviation. A dash means not analysed and is not a zero.

rows.food: Grao de bico, cozido/60 min, Cicer arietinum L.
Ervilha, cozida/30 min, Pisum sativum L.

rows.note: Carioca is the Brazilian market class, the same species as the page's pinto bean and the nearest thing this release has to it, but not the same cultivar. Hence proxy.

not-taken.Brocolos, cru (101B): Raw broccoli is in the release at 94.10 g moisture and its resistant starch cell is a dash, meaning not analysed. An earlier reading of this table reported it as 0.00 plus or minus 0.02, which is two columns further right and belongs to the fibre fractions. A false zero on a column that records analysed absences separately would have been worse than a blank.
not-taken.Feijao preto, cozido (30T): Black bean, boiled, is present but its resistant starch cell is a dash.
not-taken.Banana verde (456C, 484C): Green bananas at 10.31 and 7.31 g, the highest figures in the release. The page's banana is ripe, and green banana is a different food with famously different starch.
not-taken.Frozen and reheated variants: The release carries several foods cooked then frozen for 7 or 30 days. Those are separate preparations and are not folded into the cooked rows.
